No critical issues found.

issues: Looks great: red-themed widget with clear hazard card, white-on-red contrast is readable, '0% BRIEFED' chip + 'Open matrix' + 'Schedule toolbox' CTA are all clear and aligned. No issues.
Clean grid: sticky worker column, green ✓ cells, legend (Current / Expiring ≤30d / Expired / Not briefed) all render well. Export CSV + filter selects align nicely.

critical_code_review_comments: competency_module.py is tight at 372 lines and well-scoped — factory pattern matches risk_module / incident_workflow conventions. No splits needed.
conduct_toolbox: correctly UPSERTs by (user_id, worker_id, topic) — verified in test_conduct_idempotent_upsert. Latest-wins semantics is appropriate (re-attendance updates expiry).
_status_for_expiry: catches Exception broadly and returns 'current' as fallback — slightly lossy but acceptable for malformed legacy timestamps. Consider logging the parse failure.

competency_dashboard: Per-hazard worker_competencies query is run inside the hazard loop (N+1 pattern, where N≤unique-hazards). Acceptable today; if hazard count grows, could be flattened to one find with $in over hazard_categories.
DEFAULT_VALIDITY_DAYS = 365 and EXPIRING_SOON_DAYS = 30 are hard-coded constants — fine as defaults, body.validity_days override works (tested).
TOPIC_TO_HAZARD lookup is case-insensitive (lower() on key) — good. Unknown topics correctly fall through to 'Other'.

competency_matrix coverage pct: uses len(topics) (global topic count) as denominator — means a worker with 1/3 topics shows 33%, even if other topics aren't relevant to their trade. Acceptable for MVP; future enhancement could be trade-scoped denominators.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sidebar nav + /dashboard/competency-matrix page + conduct-modal on /dashboard/toolbox-talks + competency-widget hidden-when-empty AND visible-when-seeded all verified live)

seed_data_creation: Pytest seeds 2 TEST_iter18_-prefixed workers + 2 toolbox talks (Electrical Safety + Working at Heights) + 1 transient risk + 1 transient SWMS revision (for dashboard test); Playwright verification additionally seeded one TEST_iter18 risk + SWMS revision to validate the widget visually then deleted via direct Mongo. All TEST_-prefixed data cleaned up after run via worker_competencies / safety_toolbox_talks / workers / risks / swms_revision_tasks / notifications collection deletes.

Auth token localStorage key is 'st_token'. Cleanup pattern: delete from worker_competencies, safety_toolbox_talks (TEST_-prefix), workers (TEST_-prefix), risks (TEST_-prefix), swms_revision_tasks (TEST_-prefix), notifications where type='toolbox_conducted'. Frontend testids verified live: competency-matrix-page, cm-stat-workers/topics/coverage/expiring, cm-search, cm-filter-trade, cm-filter-role, cm-export-csv, cm-cell-{worker_id}-{topic_slug}, conduct-{item_id}, conducted-{item_id}, conduct-modal, attendees-list, conduct-notes, conduct-signed-off, conduct-submit, conduct-cancel, competency-widget, hazard-{i}, hazard-schedule-{i}. rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works per spec end-to-end. Only minor test-file fix during run: original assertion counted ALL competency rows for the topic (which included leftover rows from prior agent runs); scoped the count to the seeded test workers via $in on worker_id and re-run was clean.
